# Chapter 2 — Forces

Source: https://natureofcode.com/forces/

Key concepts: Newton’s laws, force as vector, mass and acceleration (F=ma), gravity, friction, drag, force accumulation, applying forces to movers.

Seeds:
- Forces chapter implements Newton’s second law as acceleration = force / mass.
- Gravity, friction and drag are modeled as vector forces that accumulate on objects.
- Multiple forces are summed before updating velocity and position.
